title: Nissan USA newsroom: 2017 LEAF press kit
notes: 2017 LEAF US press kit: 30 kWh laminated Li-ion, 192 cells, "revised chemistry"; S 3.6 kW charger (6.6 kW optional via Quick Charge Package), SV/SL 6.6 kW standard; quick charge port (CHAdeMO) optional on S, standard on SV/SL; no battery preconditioning described (cabin only).
